200 Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management successfully created the scanner group.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
integer
A Unix timestamp indicating the date and time when the scanner
group was created.
integer
name
required
type
creation_date
last_modification_date
A Unix timestamp indicating the date and time when the scanner
group was last modified.
integer
The unique ID of the owner of the scanner group.
string
The username of the owner of the scanner group.
integer
The UUID of the owner of the scanner group.
integer
The access permissions for the Default group.
integer
The number of scans currently tasked to the scanner group.
string
The UUID of the scanner group.
string
The type of scanner group. This is set to "load_balancing" by
default.
string
The name of the scanner group.
integer
The unique ID of the scanner group.
string
The username of the owner of the scanner group.
— 400
Returned if your request specified invalid parameters or if your request was improperly formatted.
— 403 Returned if you do not have permission to create scanner groups.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
— 500 Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management fails to create the scanner group.
